svg.title: Reptilian — Cold Blood and Scale. Draft 2 / Reptilian classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Chimeric Blood forks into Apex Instinct then Jaws of the Chimera, or Hardened Scales then Basilisk Carapace. Blood of the Brood forks into Serpent's Thirst then Feast of Scales. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Reptilian jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

BUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":4,"final":39.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Feast of Scales"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on four rows (Increase Damage Given x2 on Reptile Chimera and Cool-Blooded Empowerment; Decrease Damage Taken x1 on Reptile Chimera; Lifesteal x1 on Cool-Blooded Empowerment); Summoning: Reptile Zoo and its injected Reptile King carry only summon, injectjutsus and visual rows. The self-facing root (Chimeric Blood) forks into an Increase Damage Given route and a Decrease Damage Taken route; the circle-facing root (Blood of the Brood) is a single Foundation \u2192 Hidden \u2192 Advanced lifesteal chain. A fourth route would have to repeat one of the three tags: a second IDG Hidden Art under Blood of the Brood would twin Apex Instinct and open a second path past the IDG route ceiling (design note 2), and a second DDT or Lifesteal chain would breach the +10 single-row guardrail in a full build or duplicate an existing route on the same single row, so it is declined. Because the lifesteal side has three nodes, every legal 4 BP build contains Chimeric Blood; a mirrored layout would only move the universal node to the other root. Three distinct complete builds (Predation, Fortress, Pack sustain) exist; Predation and Fortress each have two fourth-purchase choices, Pack sustain's fourth purchase is always Chimeric Blood. 8 legal full-budget allocations, all 8 numerically non-dominated (three capstone-less hybrids only by one lifesteal point; design note 5).","design_notes":["Node split: Chimeric Blood (self-facing; both Reptile Chimera rows plus the circle's IDG row) forks into Apex Instinct \u2192 Jaws of the Chimera (Increase Damage Given 2/2/3 = +7 on two rows) and Hardened Scales \u2192 Basilisk Carapace (Decrease Damage Taken 2/3/5 = +10 on one row). Blood of the Brood (circle-facing) runs one chain, Serpent's Thirst \u2192 Feast of Scales (Lifesteal 3/3/4 = +10 on one row). 2/3/3 Foundations/Hidden/Advanced; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP.","USER DECISION (open): IDG ceiling. 01/02/03 = +7 on two rows that stack on the caster (+14), above Taiyo Kami's two-row +5. (a) Hold +5 (01 +2/02 +1/03 +2): Predation 17 row-weighted (4.25/row, 124%); peak becomes Fortress 19 (138%). (b) Keep +7, drop the +2 capstone secondaries: Predation 19 (138%); (a)+(b): peak 17. (c) Keep Draft 1 (21, 5.25/row, 153%) and rule Reptilian, Lycanthropy and Shinseina Ki (+7 two-row IDG) as one roster decision. Draft 2 holds (c) as a reversible placeholder.","Passives: the Ninjutsu IDG passive (20 + 0.15/lvl, multiplicative) and the 10% Ninjutsu Lifesteal passive stack with the rows; both buffs in one round (80% AP) give 70% \u2192 84% IDG for 2 rounds (Predation). Both IDG rows are element-less and jutsu-sourced (additive): each adds its percentage to every element-less non-pierce hit of any stat type plus elemental hits of its stat type (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73). DDT lists all four stat types, so it blunts Genjutsu hits the 10% Genjutsu IDT passive worsens.","Delivery: both carriers: 40 AP, cooldown 7, 350 chakra/stamina; windows are 2 following rounds, so at most 2 of 7 rounds carry enhanced value. Reptile Chimera is SELF, range 0. Cool-Blooded Empowerment is ALLY, range 4, AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN: the clicked tile must hold a living same-side user (the caster's own tile qualifies: util.ts 2750\u20132752); its rows apply once at cast as user effects to every same-village user within radius 1 (actions.ts 1239\u20131240; friendlyFire FRIENDLY). Not a ground effect.","Fourth purchases: Predation (01,02,03) adds Hardened Scales (hide 40%) or Blood of the Brood (lifesteal 40%); Fortress (01,04,05) adds Blood of the Brood (lifesteal 40%) or Apex Instinct (IDG 39%); Pack sustain (06,07,08) only Chimeric Blood. Capstone-less hybrids (01,02,04,06; 01,02,06,07; 01,04,06,07) are legal and numerically non-dominated by one lifesteal point each (+1 LS against +5 DDT or +3 two-row IDG); not recommended builds. Row-weighted peak 21, raw 14 (design note 2).","Shape: Decrease Damage Taken and Lifesteal are single rows and take the Taiyo Kami single-row +10 shape (2/3/5 and 3/3/4); capstone secondaries (+2) sit below the +3 Hidden Arts on their tags, so no capstone out-bids a sibling Hidden Art. For comparison, Taiyo Kami's two stacking IDG rows stop at +5 and Loup-Garou's single IDG row reaches +8; the IDG stack here is the only ceiling left open (design note 2)."],"risks":["Classification: every supported row is element-less, so no existing element isolates this kit; under the current resolver the rows are reachable only with affectedElements including None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. The tree assumes the proposed bloodline-keyed classification extension (label Reptilian). Normal-jutsu collision is unverified.","Increase Damage Given stacking: Reptile Chimera and Cool-Blooded Empowerment can both buff the caster in the same window (the caster is a legal ALLY target at the pin), so the Predation build adds +14 percentage points across the two rows (70% \u2192 84%) on top of the Ninjutsu passive; BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at the pin. Combined final damage was not simulated.","Lifesteal budget: lifesteal and vamp share one 60%-of-damage leech budget per hit. The route reaches 45% on Cool-Blooded Empowerment; a caster inside the circle adds the 10% Ninjutsu passive (55%), so any vamp or lifesteal from the main tree or items saturates the capstone. The buffed user heals from their own hits (pierce included); both must be alive; healprevent on the recipient blocks it.","Highest resolution: Cool-Blooded Empowerment's rows carry statTypes [Highest], which realizeTag resolves from the casting user's highestOffence (G16), so on an ally the efficiency ratio tests the caster's highest stat, not the ally's. Element-less rows still match every element-less hit of any stat type; only elemental hits of another stat type are excluded. Undefined highestOffence unverified.","Team dependence and village check: the circle buffs land on same-village users (getTargetUser compares villageId), so an ally from another village is not reached even though the tile filter accepts any same-side user; in a 1v1 the circle reaches only the caster. Blood of the Brood's chain therefore carries less value solo (single recipient) than in team fights.","Summoning: Reptile Zoo (PVP only) and its injected Reptile King (SPECIAL, empty bloodlineId, summon row only) have no supported rows; no node changes them, and the injected child is not counted under open decision D4 option (a). The 10% Genjutsu Increase Damage Taken passive remains a standing weakness outside the Chimera window.","Per-row intensity: the strongest full build is row-weighted 21 on 4 rows (5.25 per row against Taiyo Kami's 3.44), above the balance matrix's 125% outlier line, because every purchase lands on one of four rows; raw additions (14) are the lowest among drafted trees. Isolated as a user decision with options (a)/(b)/(c) in design note 2; Draft 2 does not retune it.","No adverse supported rows, hidden rows, item gates or ally-hazard rows exist in this kit; the unsupported visual rows (adverse) are untouched by every node. Uptime, whether a same-round buff applies to that round's hits, and AP sequencing were not verified against combat timing."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":8,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"lifesteal":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":4,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":2,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Reptilian classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Reptilian jutsu inherit Reptilian potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"lifesteal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"lifesteal":5}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"lifesteal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"lifesteal":3}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"lifesteal":6}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"lifesteal":5}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"lifesteal":6}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":4,"lifesteal":10}}]}

Every Reptilian jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Jaws of the Chimera path + Hardened Scales
Basilisk Carapace path + Blood of the Brood
Feast of Scales path + Chimeric Blood
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · LS: Lifesteal
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
